'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tony G DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tony Garcia]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
